title: DenseOpenRestrictionComparison
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field and P=(X,A) a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting] with constructible torsion abelian sheaf A [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion]. Let U be a dense open of X, j its inclusion, and B=j_!j^*A [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Use the coefficient equivalence E from abelian groups to modules over ULift Z, defined by the inverse of the forgetful equivalence from Z-modules followed by restriction of scalars along ULift Z ≃ Z. Put F=E(A) and G=E(B). Write T(F) for the alternative that F has invertible-order torsion or is p-primary for a prime p=char(k) [def-weil-pbc-primary-torsion]. C8(F) is equivalent to C8(G), where C8 is surjectivity of degree-two cohomology restriction to every open immersion [def-weil-pbc-C8].

proof.text:
Let a : W → X be any open immersion. Intersecting the dense open U with W leaves a
dense open with finite zero-dimensional complement. The open-closed sequence on X
and its restriction to W therefore identify H^2(G) with H^2(F), both on X and on W.
The pullback long exact ladder makes these identifications commute with restriction
along a. Surjectivity transports in both directions across this square of additive
equivalences: lift the corresponding class through the surjective restriction map,
then through the inverse horizontal equivalence; commutativity and injectivity of the
other horizontal equivalence give the required equality. Since a was arbitrary this
proves exactly the equivalence of the two restriction predicates.
